'''Srinivasa Murty Srinivasula''' (born 1963) is an Indian [[Cell biology|cell biologist]], a professor at the School of Biology and  [[Director (education)|Director]] of [[Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Thiruvananthapuram]] in [[Kerala]], [[India]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=2026-07-09 |title=Prof. Srinivasa Murty Srinivasula takes charge as director of IISER Thiruvananthapuram |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/kerala/prof-srinivasa-murty-srinivasula-takes-charge-as-director-of-iiser-thiruvananthapuram/article71202436.ece |access-date=2026-07-16 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}}</ref> His research field is [[apoptosis]], [[autophagy]] and [[oncology]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://iisertvm.irins.org/profile/49106|title=IRINS Profile page|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=7aqNljIAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate|title=Google Scholar profile|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref>

== Life and career ==

Professor Murty received his [[Bachelor of Science|B.Sc]] and [[Master of Science|M.Sc]] degrees from  [[Andhra University]] and his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] from the [[Banaras Hindu University]] in [[Varanasi]], India. He later moved to the [[Thomas Jefferson University]] as a research associate and became an instructor at the Sidney Kimmel Cancer Centre at [[Thomas Jefferson University]] in [[Philadelphia]], United States. During 2003–2012, he was the principal investigator at [[National Cancer Institute|National Cancer Institute, NIH, Bethesda]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.nihindia.com/cgi-bin/details.cgi?fn=Srinivasa&ln=Srinivasula|title=NIH PI|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://in.linkedin.com/in/srinivasa-srinivasula-2772405|title=Linkedin profile|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> He was Professor-in-charge (administration) at the IISER Thiruvananthapuram,<ref>{{Cite news|date=2020-03-14|title=COVID-19: IISER, IIST suspend classes|language=en-IN|work=The Hindu|url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/kerala/covid-19-iiser-iist-suspend-classes/article31069347.ece|access-date=2020-08-26|issn=0971-751X}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Prof. S. Murty Srinivasula - Personal {{!}} IISER Thiruvananthapuram|url=http://www.iisertvm.ac.in/faculty/sms/|access-date=2020-08-26|website=www.iisertvm.ac.in}}</ref> as well as a member of the IISER TVM Senate.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.iisertvm.ac.in/pages/senate|title=Senate committee|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> He also served on several institute committees.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.iisertvm.ac.in/pages/building_and_works_committee|title=Building and work committee IISER TVM|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.iisertvm.ac.in/pages/students_grievance_committee|title=students_grievance_committee|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.iisertvm.ac.in/assets/uploads/download_buffer/20200422114454students_grievance_committee.pdf|title=students_grievance_committee|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.iisertvm.ac.in/assets/uploads/download_buffer/20200422114452sc_st_cell.pdf|title=SC/ST cell|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> Previously, he served as Deputy [[Director (education)|Director]] of institue.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Deputy Director {{!}} IISER Thiruvananthapuram |url=https://www.iisertvm.ac.in/pages/deputy-director |access-date=2022-06-17 |website=www.iisertvm.ac.in}}</ref>  Currently, he is  [[Director (education)|Director]] of [[Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Thiruvananthapuram]] in [[Kerala]], [[India]]. 

== Key awards and distinctions ==
Professor Murty has received the following awards:
{{div col|colwidth=35em}}
* Kimmel Scholar (2003-2005), The [[Sidney Kimmel]] Foundation for Cancer Research, Baltimore, MD<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://iisertvm.irins.org/profile/49106 |title = Indian Research Information Network System}}</ref>
* Special Fellow (2000-2003), [[Leukemia & Lymphoma Society|The Leukemia and Lymphoma Society]], New York, NY
* Young Scientist Travel Award, [[American Association for Cancer Research]], Inc. Philadelphia
* Research Fellowships (1987-1992), [[University Grants Commission (India)]]
* National Merit Scholarships (1984 -1986), Department of Education, Government of India, New Delhi
{{div col end}}

== Publications ==
Professor Murty has published around 100 papers and reviews in international [[scientific journal]]s.<ref>{{Cite web|title=INDIAN RESEARCH INFORMATION NETWORK SYSTEM|url=http://irins.inflibnet.ac.in/|access-date=2020-08-26|website=irins.inflibnet.ac.in|language=en}}</ref>
